mechanism.moa: AMPK activator — inhibits mitochondrial complex I, reducing hepatic gluconeogenesis; also activates AMPK pathway.
mechanism.plausibility_rationale: Metformin inhibits mitochondrial complex I, impairing lactate oxidation in hepatocytes. In patients with renal impairment, accumulation leads to elevated lactate levels. Well-established pharmacological mechanism.
